projects.name: Divia Unpad TV
projects.headline: A campus voice, across three platforms.
projects.narrative: Divia Unpad TV is a campus media organization. In its three-person marketing team, I used audience insights to plan platform-specific content, activate LinkedIn and support partnership communication. The account results below reflect our shared work. My takeaway: a clear audience and a repeatable process help useful stories travel across platforms.
projects.contribution: Content planning, LinkedIn copy, audience analysis, company profile and media-partnership workflow.
projects.takeaway: Match the message to the platform. Evaluate audience growth separately from views and clicks.
projects.sampleAlt: Divia's published career-tips carousel on LinkedIn.
projects.sampleCaption: Published work · Career tips for future media interns

projects.name: TIRIZ
projects.headline: From an ice-cream story to a real-world moment.
projects.narrative: Our five-person Pancarona team ran a two-month campaign for TIRIZ, an ice-cream brand. I contributed to content strategy and execution, creator collaboration and the Choose Your Mood offline activation. Content delivery exceeded targets, while average Instagram feed reach fell short. My takeaway: evaluate delivery volume and audience response separately.
projects.contribution: Campaign strategy, editorial planning, content execution and support for creator and offline activation.
projects.takeaway: Content output and audience response need separate evaluation.
projects.sampleAlt: A visitor using TIRIZ's Choose Your Mood booth board.
projects.sampleCaption: Campaign in the real world · Choose Your Mood activation

projects.name: Cakradata
projects.headline: Making technology relevant to student life.
projects.narrative: At Cakradata, a technology company, I researched audiences, monitored media and turned student needs into content plans, soft-selling copy and technology explainers. I also contributed on camera. Selected top posts recorded 13,000 TikTok views and 2,000 Instagram views. My takeaway: start with a familiar audience need, then explain the product benefit.
projects.contribution: Audience research, student-focused content planning, soft-selling copy and multimedia support.
projects.takeaway: Explain the benefit in the audience's language before introducing the product.
projects.sampleAlt: Student-oriented laptop and technology content in the supplied Cakradata work sample.
